criteria.requirement: Add exported EventIter following AbstractIter constructor conventions. Yield (event, actual_node, depth) with event enter/leave and zero-based root depth. A complete traversal pairs visible nodes exactly once, preserves child order, uses an explicit stack, and supports deep trees without changing recursion limits. filter_ hides only that node events, stop prunes the subtree, and maxlevel=1 includes only the root (nonpositive levels yield none). Evaluate visibility once per visited node. A partially consumed iterator promises only its actual prefix, not invented closing events. Preserve existing iterators.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
